description: Election Commission - Declare K. D. L. Premathilaka Elected as Chairman of the Wariyapola Pradeshiya Sabha (Cancellation is Linked to Gaz. No. 2271/35 Date 16.03.2022)
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the office of chairman of a local authority (Wariyapola Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including the nomination and declaration of an elected official, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
